definition_used: One or more third parties misunderstood one or more parts of a message sent to and/or from one or more third parties.
caution: The definition describes a communication error involving third parties, not a direct issue with research content, authorship, editorial processes, or post-publication oversight. It lacks substantive connection to manuscript integrity categories.
semantic_rationale: The reason describes a misunderstanding in communication by a third party, which is a procedural or transparency notice about an external error, not a reliability, attribution, governance, or oversight issue with the manuscript itself.
